$comment: Generated-by-hand from frontend/src/app/globals.css @theme and verified against it by frontend/design-tests/tokens.design.test.mjs. The test is the generator's stand-in: if this file and the CSS disagree, the suite fails. Semantic slots are named for MENGER's own verdict tokens, not for generic dashboard severities — there is no 'success' in a product whose proudest state is a refusal to decide.
name: MENGER

spacing.note: 4px unit; every gap is a multiple of it

radii.note: three rungs, no xl — a declared-but-unassigned 12px radius was removed rather than left reserved; a token nothing uses is a scale that lies about its own range

motion.reducedMotion: global kill-switch in globals.css; no per-component opt-out

contrast.floorSurface: ink-4 (#242a35), the lightest surface any text sits on

signatureElement: The Split Rule — every source drawn as an IN half and an OUT half separated by a visible gap and joined by one hairline, the unit-capacity edge that makes independence a count of vertex-disjoint chains.

signatureObject.name: The Split Rule
signatureObject.thesis: The product's whole claim is that corroboration must be counted over vertex-disjoint chains, and the only thing that makes that true is splitting every source into two nodes joined by a single unit-capacity edge. Drawing that cut IS drawing the mechanism, so the signature is not a motif applied to the product — it is the product at glyph scale.

perSurface.landing: ARGUMENT scale. The split at hero size: the SplitMark in the wordmark and CTA with the cut animating open once, and the refused claim set against the admitted claim as two columns that are themselves a split — same citation count, different provenance, different number.
perSurface.console: LABEL scale. A 12-16px inline SplitMark beside independence figures and split-pair links, plus the si:/so: pair rendered as two chips with the cut between them. It never animates. In the console the mark labels; it never argues. Console is deliberately not the landing form.
perSurface.graph: SUBJECT scale. On /slots/[key]/graph the split is not the component at all — it is drawn full-size from live payload nodes and edges, with the cap label read from the data. Substituting the glyph here would be drawing a picture of evidence instead of the evidence.

invariantPhrase: Two citations are not two sources.
